items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: Jack Sharp was real popular down there Jack was a sort of a character and he was uh one of the first people that I knew that became chord conscious

ctx.x: he was a clarinet player for me he wrote Lazy Riffles and he played around Texas some he and Red Bowman and Charlie Cardillo and piano player whose name I can't think of I think he's a Texan big friend of T God and a composer let's see who else was in the band

this guy's name begins with a T I think his first name something like Trent but anyway he was in the band and Jack T Godden was in the band and that's when T Godden went to New York after he left this band
